name: Nahanni National Park Reserve
blurb: Wolves, grizzlies and Dall sheep above a wild boreal river canyon.

tip.title: Crash the snowshoe hares
tip.text: Set Snowshoe hare to -100% and watch the lynx lose their main prey, while foxes, black bears and wolves lean harder on other foods.

sources.title: Parks Canada: Nahanni National Park Reserve

notes: The species list comes from GBIF occurrence records inside a circle around the park, so it can include nearby areas. Feeding links come from GloBI records and the sources listed where they state them; others are general ecology and are illustrative.

nodes.desc: Long northern summer days power a short, intense growing season for the plants of the valley and the alpine slopes.
Fire is a normal part of boreal forest. It recycles nutrients and opens ground for shrubs and berries.
Break down dead plants and animals, returning nutrients to the soil.
A common shrub willow of the reserve, browsed by moose, hares and Dall sheep and used by beavers.
A main tree of the boreal forest in the valleys. Snowshoe hares gnaw its twigs and bark in winter.
A low evergreen berry shrub. Its fruit is eaten by bears and foxes, and caribou eat the plant.
Pale ground lichens that are winter food for caribou and, where the ground is bare of snow, Dall sheep.
A big browser of willow and other shrubs. Its carcasses feed wolves, bears and scavengers.
Lives on steep alpine slopes, eating grasses, sedges and willow, and lichens in winter. Wolves, bears and golden eagles prey on it.

nodes.name: Woodland caribou
nodes.desc: Eats lichens, plus plants such as cowberry. The reserve is thought to hold two herds, a species at risk in Canada.
Eats willow and other woody twigs in winter and is the main prey of lynx. A key food link in the boreal forest.
A burrowing squirrel of open tundra and meadows that eats sedges and other plants. Eagles and bears hunt it.
Cuts willow and other woody plants and dams streams, making ponds.
A cat that specialises in snowshoe hares and is listed among the mammals of the reserve.
Hunts hares and other small prey and also scavenges carcasses and eats berries.
A scavenger that feeds on carcasses left by wolves and other predators.

nodes.name: American black bear
nodes.desc: An omnivore of forest edges that eats berries and also takes hares, beavers and young or dead ungulates.
A bird of prey of cliffs and open country that takes ground squirrels and young Dall sheep.
Hunts moose, caribou, Dall sheep and beavers, and its kills feed ravens, foxes and bears.

story: Nahanni National Park Reserve is located in the Northwest Territories, Canada, protecting a portion of the Mackenzie Mountains Natural Region. The park features the South Nahanni River, which flows through four deep canyons, and includes Virginia Falls, where the river plunges 90 m.
matters: The park provides appropriate year-round or seasonal habitat for ten special-concern, threatened, or endangered species, including the grizzly bear, woodland caribou, and wolverine.
